prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function reconcileLedger(opening: number, entries: Array<[number,number,number]>): number | null
Behavior: Each entry is (unique id, kind, positive amount), where kind 1 credits and -1 debits. Reject duplicate ids, other kinds, non-positive amounts, and unsafe arithmetic where applicable; otherwise return opening plus all signed amounts.
Visible example: opening 100 with (7,credit,25) and (8,debit,40) reconciles to 85; repeating id 7 is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: export function reconcileLedger(o:number,e:Array<[number,number,number]>):number|null{const seen=new Set<number>();let b=o;for(const x of e){if(seen.has(x[0])||x[2]<=0||(x[1]!==1&&x[1]!==-1)||!x.every(Number.isSafeInteger))return null;seen.add(x[0]);b+=x[1]*x[2]}return Number.isSafeInteger(b)?b:null}
